description: “This is a frustrating reminder of how, less than one year ago, City Hall blindsided communities throughout the city, especially on Staten Island, where migrants were warehoused in hotels by the hundreds. Then, just like now, city officials insisted that it would be temporary and non-intrusive. In time we learned that was a lie — and so we should know better than to believe it this time.”
